title: Demonstrators and Product Promoters
description: Demonstrate merchandise and answer questions for the purpose of creating public interest in buying the product. May sell demonstrated merchandise.

tasks.text: Provide product samples, coupons, informational brochures, or other incentives to persuade people to buy products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically distributing samples and literature

dwas.name: Distribute promotional literature or samples to customers.

tasks.text: Sell products being promoted and keep records of sales.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain structured sales records via tools

dwas.name: Maintain records of sales or other business transactions.

tasks.text: Keep areas neat while working and return items to correct locations following demonstrations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of work areas

tasks.text: Demonstrate or explain products, methods, or services to persuade customers to purchase products or use services.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Technical explanation to customers needs live interaction

dwas.name: Explain technical product or service information to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Record and report demonstration-related information, such as the number of questions asked by the audience or the number of coupons distributed.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Structured transaction data entry and recording

tasks.text: Suggest specific product purchases to meet customers' needs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Product recommendations need customer context and persuasion

dwas.name: Recommend products or services to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Research or investigate products to be presented to prepare for demonstrations.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI extracts product specs and summarizes

dwas.name: Study product information to acquire professional knowledge.

tasks.text: Set up and arrange displays or demonstration areas to attract the attention of prospective customers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Setting up displays requires hands-on placement

tasks.text: Identify interested and qualified customers to provide them with additional information.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI analyzes market data to identify prospects

tasks.text: Visit trade shows, stores, community organizations, or other venues to demonstrate products or services or to answer questions from potential customers.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Product questions answered from knowledge base

dwas.name: Answer customer questions about goods or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Transport, assemble, and disassemble materials used in presentations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Setting up displays requires hands-on placement

tasks.text: Practice demonstrations to ensure that they will run smoothly.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live product demonstration requires physical presence

tasks.text: Learn about competitors' products or consumers' interests or concerns to answer questions or provide more complete information.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI extracts product specs and summarizes

dwas.name: Gather customer or product information to determine customer needs.
Study product information to acquire professional knowledge.

tasks.text: Instruct customers in alteration of products.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Product-use advice is largely informational with review

dwas.name: Advise customers on the use of products or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Work as part of a team of demonstrators to accommodate large crowds.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live product demonstration requires physical presence

tasks.text: Prepare or alter presentation contents to target specific audiences.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Generates sales content drafts; human tailors and approves

dwas.name: Develop content for sales presentations or other materials.

tasks.text: Stock shelves with products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically moving and shelving stock items

tasks.text: Provide product information, using lectures, films, charts, or slide shows.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Slides drafted; live delivery and persuasion are human

dwas.name: Deliver promotional presentations to current or prospective customers.

tasks.text: Train demonstrators to present a company's products or services.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Sales coaching blends persuasion and live practice

tasks.text: Recommend product or service improvements to employers.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Product recommendations need customer context and persuasion

dwas.name: Recommend products or services to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Wear costumes or sign boards and walk in public to promote merchandise, services, or events.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical modeling presence is the work
